name: Helena
message: 「Oh, welcome. You came by again today, didn't you?」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, you're really working hard~~ Are you getting close to completing all the trophies soon?」

name: Helena
message: 「Heehee... Let's see. Once you've collected them all, I'll prepare a little reward for you.」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, look forward to it, okay?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh? It looks like you've met the conditions to get a trophy in the game.」

name: Helena
message: 「Thank you for playing so much! Please keep supporting Twinkle\s07 Crusaders!」

name: Helena
message: 「To someone as wonderful as you, I present this trophy!」

name: Helena
message: 「You have stolen something very precious... and that is the heroine's heart!」

name: Helena
message: 「And so, here's your trophy♪」

name: Helena
message: 「Congratulations! Thanks to the Demon Lord, the evil in everyone's hearts has safely vanished!」

name: Helena
message: 「As a token of gratitude, I present this trophy!」

name: Helena
message: 「Eating every single sweet is amazing! At this rate, you won't even lose to Nanaka!!」

name: Helena
message: 「As the Chairwoman of Ryuusei Academy, I commend you!」

name: Helena
message: 「Splendid!! You crushed Misa completely and utterly. Those many great matches truly moved me!」

name: Helena
message: 「To you who shines in the glory of victory, I present this trophy!」

name: Helena
message: 「Fufu. I like Japanese sweets too. Devouring every last one of them would surprise even Ria!」

name: Helena
message: 「Be careful not to gain weight, okay? Here, take this.」

name: Helena
message: 「Geez, you're still growing... You have to eat proper meals. You won't get big otherwise, you know?」

name: Helena
message: 「Still, they're super convenient when you're busy! For getting full completion, I'll give you this.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, using mail order this much practically qualifies you for a gold card! Not bad~~ Just like Melilot!」

name: Helena
message: 「To commemorate being comrades, here you go.」

name: Helena
message: 「As of today, you maggots graduate from being worthless scum. From this day forward, you are full-fledged Crusaders.」

name: Helena
message: 「Until the day you drop dead, no matter where you are, the Crusaders are your comrades.」

name: Helena
message: 「Engrave this upon your souls. The Crusaders are eternal. In other words--you are eternal as well!」

name: Helena
message: 「My! You actually defeated Melilot! You're pretty capable behind that cute face, aren't you!」

name: Helena
message: 「I got to see that frustrated look on Melilot's face, and... since I'm so happy, I'll give you this♪」

name: Helena
message: 「Amazing! To think you'd actually get a GOD rank... Even I'm surprised!」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm so glad to see the Crusaders grow so splendidly... To commemorate it, allow me to present you with this trophy.」

name: Helena
message: 「A flawless combination attack... Everyone moving in perfect sync without a single misstep. How wonderful!」

name: Helena
message: 「To celebrate pulling off a pure 5-person unison, here's this trophy as a gift!」

name: Helena
message: 「Angels, demons, and humans alike... making allies of them all and turning them into your strength. Yes, that is what a true Demon Lord is!」

name: Helena
message: 「Your bond... I've certainly seen it for myself. A toast to a wonderful Demon Lord♪」
